moments.evidence: Un titella de tela és dret sobre una base baixa. La pilota d’escuma és a la mà.
Després del llançament curt, la pilota d’escuma impacta el tronc del titella i el fa bascular.
El titella queda estès a la mateixa base, amb la pilota al costat.

continuity.anchor: Un titella amb dues orelles desiguals i una pilota tova amb franja.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic bear; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un titella de tela és dret sobre una base baixa. La pilota d’escuma és a la mà. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Després del llançament curt, la pilota d’escuma impacta el tronc del titella i el fa bascular. RIGHT result: El titella queda estès a la mateixa base, amb la pilota al costat. Continuity and accounting: Un titella amb dues orelles desiguals i una pilota tova amb franja. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
attempts.review: Només hi ha un ninot articulat que sosté la pilota i després cau. No es distingeixen l’ós que fa el llançament i el titella de roba que rep l’impacte.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic bear; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un titella de tela és dret sobre una base baixa. La pilota d’escuma és a la mà. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Després del llançament curt, la pilota d’escuma impacta el tronc del titella i el fa bascular. RIGHT result: El titella queda estès a la mateixa base, amb la pilota al costat. Continuity and accounting: Un titella amb dues orelles desiguals i una pilota tova amb franja. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Exactly TWO visibly distinct beings: actor is a live anthropomorphic brown bear in a bright blue shirt and trousers kneeling to the LEFT on the floor, holds ball in first panel. Target is a much smaller green cloth puppet with two long uneven floppy ears and visible sewn seams standing on a low wooden base on the RIGHT. Plush puppet never holds the ball. Bear tosses ball at puppet and bear remains upright in all panels. Puppets wears no blue.
attempts.review: Es distingeixen l’ós que llança i el titella verd de roba. La pilota toca el tronc del titella, que es tomba sobre la seva base. Es conserven la pilota i les dues orelles desiguals.
